'''Jolor Oron''' was a [[Human replica droid|replica droid]] that had the appearance of a tall, slender long-lived [[near-Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Oron was modified by a technician whose family had been [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], turning Oron into a weapon, to destroy all of the droids in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Oron eventually became the leader of the [[Droid Equality Foundation]], a large and powerful droid rights group, and he planned to use the organization to turn the opinion of the galactic population against droids.
